les: Water hou vir die dag wanneer dit nie reën nie
kaps_punt: Berging van water: Waarom moet mense water stoor; Maniere om water te stoor - soos in damme, watertenke, emmers en potte

items.bewering: Die San het al lank gelede water in volstruiseierdoppe gestoor.
items.bron: Origins Centre (Wits), 'Fascinating Technologies Used by the San People of Southern Africa' (Google Arts & Culture): San in arid regions used ostrich egg shells to store water, holes plugged. Francis Galton, The Art of Travel (1855), p. 237 (galton.org) documents it in the 19th century; Morris 1994, South African Field Archaeology 3:55-58 (journals.uj.ac.za) on an archaeological eggshell-container cache at Vaalbos.
